text:
sara: quick sync — prepping pavo-6b for serving. Weights uploaded to s3://rw-model-artifacts/pavo/6b/v2/weights.pt, tokenizer at s3://rw-model-artifacts/pavo/6b/v2/tokenizer.zip. model_card currently lists usage_restrictions: "no_commercial" and requires attribution. Can we confirm this blocks Hosted paid-tier and what exact attribution text we need? cc @kevin @olga @maria-legal

kevin: infra/serving note — config validator failed with a `vocab_size` mismatch between the model and tokenizer. Try: `./bin/validate_model --weights s3://rw-model-artifacts/pavo/6b/v2/weights.pt --tokenizer s3://rw-model-artifacts/pavo/6b/v2/tokenizer.zip` to see exact diffs. Also ensure weights are sharded or a manifest is present; runtime expects either `model_index.json` (manifest) or sharded files named `shard-0000.bin`, etc. Did you upload a manifest? :eyes:

olga: checked the bucket — weights are a single `weights.pt` with no manifest.json. Hosting layer prefers a small `model_index.json` for efficient downloads. I'll prepare a manifest and a checksum. Also spotted tokenizer is `bytebpe` but missing "<bos>"/"<s>" in `special_tokens` — that's why we saw prompt duplication in smoke tests. Quick fix: add "\"bos_token\": \"<s>\"" (or map "<bos>" to "<s>") in `tokenizer_config.json`.

maria-legal: on the usage_restrictions: `no_commercial` (NC) prohibits commercial exploitation. That means:
- Not allowed on paid Hosted endpoints or for commercial customers
- Allowed on Dedicated/Private deployments if the customer signs our indemnity and we include attribution in the model_card
Please add an explicit attribution string. Recommended format: `Model: pavo-6b (PavoAI); License: CC-BY-NC-4.0`. Put that under `model_card.attribution`. Also flag the registry entry with `hosting_allowed: false` until product/legal sign off.

kevin: infra example for `model_index.json` (root of model repo) — save as `model_index.json`:
```
{
  "model_type": "decoder_only",
  "weights": ["shard-0000.bin"],
  "tokenizer": "tokenizer.json",
  "framework": "pt",
  "sha256": "<sha256-of-shard>"
}
```
That `sha256` helps runtime verify integrity on pull.

sara: thanks — i'll re-upload with manifest + tokenizer_config now. Quick legal Q: if product wants to enable this for a research-only free sandbox (no monetization), is that allowed under NC? We'll still need attribution and a clear TOS notice.

maria-legal: free research sandbox is OK if strictly non-commercial and users are informed of the NC restriction. We should keep `hosting_allowed: false` for paid-serving and add `allowed_environments: ["internal","research_sandbox"]` to the registry metadata for clarity. Product needs to confirm they can enforce the restriction in the UI and billing.

infra-bot: deploy-checker: initial config validation FAILED (vocab_size mismatch). Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/9921. Re-run validator after you push the manifest/tokenizer fixes.

kevin: +1 on `hosting_allowed`. Also remind: runtime requires tokenizer_config.json with `special_tokens_map` and `bos_token`/`eos_token` entries if the tokenizer deviates from our defaults. That solves the duplication artifact.

sara: uploaded manifest (model_index.json), updated tokenizer_config.json to include `bos_token` and `special_tokens_map`, and added `model_card.attribution = \"Model: pavo-6b (PavoAI); License: CC-BY-NC-4.0\"`. Running validator now.

deploy-bot: deploy-checker: validation PASSED. Note: hosting still blocked due to usage_restrictions (`no_commercial`). Assigning to @product for business decision on sandbox / paid offering. :thumbsup:

sara: great — leaving as Private/Dedicated-ready for now. tagging @product for follow-up and will keep registry flag `hosting_allowed: false` until we get legal + product sign-off. Thanks all!
